latest.content:

Manolete Partners PLC
("Manolete" or the "Company")
Large case settlement of £3.4 million
Manolete (AIM:MANO), the UK's leading insolvency claims financing company, is pleased to announce the successful completion of a large case in July 2026, with a £3.425 million settlement payment received in the same month.
Manolete's share of this settlement forms part of the Company's expected realised revenues for the current financial year alongside realisations from its portfolio of other cases. The Board's expectations remain unchanged.
The Manolete effect
The case completion announced today demonstrates the value Manolete brings to insolvency estates and the efficacy of the Manolete model to deliver specialist finance and litigation expertise.
Following assignment of the claims, Manolete undertook investigation and analysis of the claims. Urgent action was taken to preserve assets and proceedings were issued in the High Court.
By purchasing the claim, financing the litigation, obtaining asset preservation measures and pursuing recovery through the courts, Manolete converted a complex and potentially high-risk insolvency claim that could otherwise have remained dormant into a multi-million-pound recovery. The insolvency practitioner was able to realise value from the claim without committing estate funds to lengthy and expensive litigation, ultimately improving the prospects of returns to creditors.

latest.title: Manolete ranked in Band 1 by Chambers for 6th year
latest.content:

Manolete Partners PLC

RNS REACH
26 June 2026
MANOLETE PARTNERS PLC
("Manolete" or the "Company")
Manolete awarded prestigious Band 1 ranking by Chambers for sixth year in a row
CEO Mena Halton ranked in Band 1 for fifth year; two colleagues also ranked
Manolete (AIM:MANO), the UK's leading insolvency claims financing company, is pleased to announce that it has maintained its Band 1 ranking by Chambers for Litigation Funding: Insolvency. Manolete is the only company to be ranked Band 1 for six years in a row.
Manolete Chief Executive Officer, Mena Halton has also retained her status as a Band 1 ranked lawyer for Litigation Funding: Insolvency. She has been ranked Band 1 in every year from 2022-26. Mena joined the Company in 2014 and was appointed to the Manolete Board as Managing Director in June 2022 before being appointed CEO in August 2025.
Manolete's General Counsel, Ronan Butler and Associate Director, Andrew Murphy have also achieved Band 3 ranking this year for the first time.
Chambers and Partners is an independent research company operating across 200 jurisdictions delivering detailed rankings and insight into the world's leading lawyers. Chambers' 200 Research Analysts provide unique insight into complex areas of law in different jurisdictions. Chambers conducts tens of thousands of interviews a year with in-house counsel and third-party experts, such as barristers and accountants, delivering detailed insight into providers of legal services.
Mena Halton, Chief Executive Officer, said:
"We are delighted to again be recognised by Chambers for the market-leading standard of our work. Achieving a Band 1 ranking for the sixth year in a row sets Manolete apart and is testament to the exceptional quality and dedication of our team of insolvency litigation specialists.
"I am honoured to retain my own Band 1 status and want to congratulate two colleagues who have joined the rankings. This is a fantastic accolade and strong proof of the depth of legal quality and leadership that we have at Manolete as we continue to lead in our field."
